selectedProcedure.activation: Action; perceived point within30feet and casting-point LoE; V/S/F; native rank7/base17RP using actual acquired class engine.
selectedProcedure.NEW_area: At successful resolution snapshot ALL actual extraplanar-tagged creatures whose full occupied body has positive-volume intersection with the30foot-radius3D sphere and an unobstructed center-to-body witness. Same-plane snapshot at original field origin. No caster exemption or alliance exception. Stable immutable creature-ID order is fixed before saves or any admission. Full separate bodies, passengers and mount identities are not gear. The source creates no physical persistent hazard or later-entry trigger.
selectedProcedure.NEW_eligibility: A governing current source must explicitly establish extraplanar status. The accepted Greater Planar Ally source explicit tag qualifies without a known home destination; its full card is bound alongside this procedure. Appearance, outsider-looking anatomy, current absence from a presumed home, character ancestry, summoning school and a creature-type label are insufficient. Unknown records remain unresolved whole-case prerequisites, not a negative alignment or home-plane diagnosis.
selectedProcedure.NEW_cells_and_duration: M136-FIELD-CELL-01 expressly extends the independently retained ordinary Banishment cell/cargo/closure model to this spell. At legal commitment start one concentration parent; maximum60elapsed seconds from successful field resolution, expressly replacing historical Instantaneous. All admissions share this one original parent deadline; each body has its own original source child, cell, origin/cargo snapshot, save and result. No shared cell, damage, stun or home-plane deportation is added.
selectedProcedure.NEW_admission: Each snapshotted eligible body makes its own CHA save against the original actual casting-class DC. Record ACCEPT or RESIST before that save; ACCEPT may elect failure under this explicit new extension of BAN-SAVE-01, not a general save-waiver rule. Success means no exile, no damage and no hard-control consumption. Failed saves separately attempt actual lawful whole-body admission under original source guards, local blockers and actual physical separation. Claim the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control component only on a real successful exile. A prior spent component prevents this exile; no soft substitute is added. Failure of one admission does not cancel the other original snapshotted results. Caster becoming one admitted body does not create a new origin or cancel the already fixed field transaction.
selectedProcedure.NEW_cell_contents: For every admitted current body use the exact original Banishment cell dimension algorithm, source-local sustaining medium/light/floor and boundary/mandatory-ending rules bound below. Preserve the real body, current HP, class engine, independent source clocks, actual carried noncreature cargo and immutable creator. Keep independent creatures at lawful origin placements; inseparability defeats only that admission atomically. Supplies, soul facts, resources, native planes, copied corpses or additional free objects are not formed.
selectedProcedure.NEW_terminal_exception: M136-FIELD-CLOSE-01 is a NEW named extension only for terminal return of these actual field-created cells. On parent concentration ending, caster death/incapacity, original deadline, actual parent termination or local suppression of that child exile expression, close the affected child immediately; suppression ends that child rather than pausing a live cell. Its mandatory plane-return step ignores teleport/planar/anti-return prevention only to the exact extent copied in the bound ordinary BAN-CLOSE-03 contract. Then the full ordinary collision-safe placement/conflict and external-item rules still apply, with stable child admission order when multiple bodies return to occupied origins. No physical wall bypass, free future travel, revived expired companion or recreated cargo is granted. The field parent may continue for other still-live children until it ends. Suppression reaching only the remote caster does not reach a child in its separate cell.

sourceConflict.catalog: Rulebook catalog says only: Send a creature to another plane temporarily; catalog duration unspecified.
sourceConflict.core: Core entry supplies Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, 7 RP and duration Instantaneous.
sourceConflict.disposition: Preserve both original records unchanged. For provisional runnability, author NEW concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds while retaining Instantaneous as historical/source metadata. This is an explicit authored reconciliation, not a rewrite of either source.

questionDispositions.reason: A generated isolated extraplanar spell-cell preserves the printed temporary-other-plane effect without naming or identifying any reviewed plane. The draft topology is retained only as a local spell-space and revised to an elastic finite enclosure so body/atomic geometry changes do not require a hidden preemptive interrupt.

Use Action/60 ft/V-S-F/base 7 RP and actual class spell DC; NEW CHA save, willing pre-roll failure, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, one-live-application guard, and the existing shared hard-control allowance. Concentration begins at legal cast commitment and a failed/countered cast does not restore displaced concentration.

Use finite BAN-CLOSE-03. No pre-change early-return interrupt exists. Mandatory source events resolve normally. When Banishment ends, remaining identities are moved to the snapshotted origin plane despite a narrow terminal endpoint-blocker exception, then physical fitting is resolved by the already accepted canonical placement procedure. An unresolved physical placement conflict is an origin-plane state, not continuing exile.

Independently legal visitors and internally created creatures retain their own real permissions/costs. Their source must target a currently fitting, perceived in-cell footprint; Banishment cannot expand first to create target legality. At closure, all remaining real identities are returned once in stable order and handed to canonical placement; ended/escaped/consumed identities are not recreated.

The spell transports exactly the selected creature plus genuine noncreature worn/carried gear. Separate creature bodies—including passengers, mounts, swallowed creatures and companions—do not become gear. Impossible separation/tethers can defeat establishment. Transformations, death, body removal, Null Disabled summons and cargo keep their own source lifecycles.

Use accepted AC4 interfaces: rank-4 Banishment is ineligible for Spell Shield; Dimensional Anchor blocks ordinary planar endpoints; Resonance Beacon remains same-plane; Xi can end only the actual ongoing target branch with its exact consent/perception/range/charge procedure. Cleric Banish Unholy remains a different class technique.

Keep Paladin cards exact. NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 classifies this spell only as planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape blocks only voluntarily accepted Banishment because it expressly includes voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute does not block Banishment because it names only teleportation/invisibility; Reign of Ashes does not block because it denies benefit from Dash/teleportation. A pre-save acceptance flag determines voluntary versus forced admission whether the target elects failure or rolls.

BAN-ADMIT-03 allows a visitor/created body only through its own real destination/creation permission, cost and a fitting currently perceived in-cell footprint. No expansion can supply prior target perception/LoE. After legal establishment the cell may expand only for clearance. Admission grants no route, knowledge, immunity or return resource.

No universal interrupt or rewind is created. Mandatory transformations/death/expiry complete under their actual source. Cell geometry expands after mandatory in-cell anatomy changes as needed. Final Banishment ending uses BAN-CLOSE-03 and canonical placement-conflict handling on the origin plane; no future ruling is needed for ordinary collapse/filled-space cases.

Accepted AC4 procedures are interoperability authority only within their recorded scope; lexical class hits are navigation evidence only. Preserve all historical scenario text as evidence, author current adjudications separately, and claim no runtime/human/balance approval.

castAndSave.target: One actually perceived creature within 60 feet and line of effect, including the caster; not a corpse, image, soul record or unattended object.
castAndSave.commit: Validate known class/repertoire, V/S/F, Action, range/line of effect, affordability, concentration permission, obvious body/custody impossibilities and obvious transport blocks. Pay the actual final spell price and perform ordinary cast/counter timing. NEW concentration begins at legal cast commitment and displaces incompatible prior concentration normally.
castAndSave.save: NEW BAN-SAVE-01: target makes a Charisma save against the actual casting-class spell DC. Before rolling, target records admissionIntent = ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT may either elect automatic failure or roll normally; if it rolls and fails, establishment is still voluntary. RESIST plus failed save is involuntary. Actual save bonuses/defenses apply, including Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment. Success creates no cell and no exile.
castAndSave.hardControl: On a failed save, establishment is one hard encounter-removal component under the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance. If that allowance cannot be claimed, no exile/cell is established and no soft fallback is invented. The paid cast remains spent.
castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

currentInterfaces.spellShield: Banishment is generating rank 4 and therefore does not satisfy accepted Spell Shield rank 0–3 eligibility, regardless of discounts.
currentInterfaces.dimensionalAnchor: At establishment, Dimensional Anchor applies under its accepted endpoint rule and can defeat the planar transition. During voluntary escape it applies normally. At BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal ending, the mandatory-plane-return step uses only the narrowly scoped endpointBlockerException; physical fit is never ignored and is resolved afterward by BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03.
currentInterfaces.resonanceBeacon: Beacon requires same-plane traveler/beacon. A Beacon outside the cell does not become same-plane. A Beacon created inside obeys its actual rules but does not create an outside destination.
currentInterfaces.xi: Xi Declare Contradiction can end the ongoing Banishment creature-target branch only through its actual Action, 60-foot perception, known spell record, caster+target consent and charge procedure. Isolation may make those predicates unavailable; possession alone is not remote release.
currentInterfaces.fateBound: Actual Oracle Fate-Bound Boon IV grants its +2 against banishment saves; no generic Oracle immunity exists.
currentInterfaces.paladin: NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 applies only to ordinary Banishment: it is planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape (/cards/41) blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because it expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; it does not block RESIST+failed-save forced exile. Verdict Absolute (/cards/43) names only voluntary teleportation/invisibility, so it does not block either Banishment branch. Reign of Ashes (/cards/130) denies benefit from Dash/teleportation; it does not block Banishment. Chain of Duty still requires same plane.
currentInterfaces.cleric: Cleric Banish Unholy remains its own class card: WIS save, radiant damage/push and possible until-end-next-turn banishment rider. It does not borrow this ordinary spell's cell/save/duration.
currentInterfaces.nullSummons: A finite summoned body that is Null Disabled at 0 remains the same body while its source persists. Banishment does not heal/refresh it. Independent summon concentration/deadline/end remains real; if it ends in the cell, there is no body to eject.

transportClassification.rule: Ordinary Banishment is planar/extradimensional displacement. It is not teleportation. This classification exists only to adjudicate this spell against exact current predicates and does not redefine other planar effects.

paladinConsequences.No Escape: Blocks ACCEPT because the card expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; does not stop forced RESIST+failed-save exile.
paladinConsequences.Verdict Absolute: Does not block Banishment because its card forbids only voluntary teleportation/invisibility.
paladinConsequences.Reign of Ashes: Does not block Banishment because its card denies benefit from Dash/teleportation and Banishment is not teleportation.

procedure.castingAndFormation: KEEP Conjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and one hour of extraplanar assistance. NEW no concentration; exactly3600elapsed seconds from successful formation. Choose one perceived unoccupied actual10x10foot whole-body space with at least10feet vertical clearance in range and line of effect, on support capable of the body plus actual admitted cargo. Known illegality fails preflight; hidden or intervening invalidity defeats the paid formation without a substitute location. A countered cast creates no replacement. A successful new Greater Planar Ally replaces the caster's previous Greater Planar Ally, wherever it is, conserving real property.
procedure.identityAndRole: NEW explicitly form the complete summon-only profile AC6-GREATER-PLANAR-ALLY-PROFILE-01. This is a new finite creature identity, not a transport/copy/conscription of a named existing person or an automatic grant to choose any printed CR6 monster. It preserves the source's CR6 assistance role as a design target. Eight actual CR6 entries in the bounded67-entry source candidate are preserved for comparison; none is treated as operationally approved or extraplanar solely from its type. The proposed120HP/AC17/two2d8+4 profile and intended challenge role need numerical playtesting. Extraplanar is an explicit source tag; no specific home/native plane or soul has been invented. Formation is this spell's creature-creation event, not traveler transit; a rule preventing actual planar travel does not automatically suppress creation unless its exact text covers it.
procedure.commandAndAssistance: Use the actual owner-wide Bonus Action command during the owner's regular turn, within60feet, with owner perception/line of effect and a command the ally can actually hear. Execute one movement budget and one selected legal Action in the attached phase after the entire owner turn. A valid offensive command permits its two printed strikes within one offensive Action, not two owner commands. Choose legal targets and any lawful alternatives from what the owner actually perceives when commanding; revalidate reach, target and line of effect at each attack. Split the one movement budget before/between attacks if declared. A miss or invalid later target does not refund offense or grant a hidden new target. Other companions cannot spend a second offensive Action that numbered round. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge while capable. No independent initiative turn or extra-turn reset is created.
procedure.noncombatUse: A real command may direct its profiled basic Action, manipulation or Search. Carrying and movement use the actual profile and real spent time. It may move supplied cargo or manipulate an unattended simple object, but it supplies no automatic Help advantage, profession, autonomous offscreen project, expedition roster office, extra Watch, training or institutional service. procedure.castingAndFormation: KEEP Conjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and one hour of extraplanar assistance. NEW no concentration; exactly3600elapsed seconds from successful formation. Choose one perceived unoccupied actual10x10foot whole-body space with at least10feet vertical clearance in range and line of effect, on support capable of the body plus actual admitted cargo. Known illegality fails preflight; hidden or intervening invalidity defeats the paid formation without a substitute location. A countered cast creates no replacement. procedure.identityAndRole: NEW explicitly form the complete summon-only profile AC6-GREATER-PLANAR-ALLY-PROFILE-01. This is a new finite creature identity, not a transport/copy/conscription of a named existing person or an automatic grant to choose any printed CR6 monster. It preserves the source's CR6 assistance role as a design target. Eight actual CR6 entries in the bounded67-entry source candidate are preserved for comparison; none is treated as operationally approved or extraplanar solely from its type. The proposed120HP/AC17/two2d8+4 profile and intended challenge role need numerical playtesting. Extraplanar is an explicit source tag; no specific home/native plane or soul has been invented. Formation is this spell's creature-creation event, not traveler transit; a rule preventing actual planar travel does not automatically suppress creation unless its exact text covers it.
procedure.commandAndAssistance: Use the actual owner-wide Bonus Action command during the owner's regular turn, within60feet, with owner perception/line of effect and a command the ally can actually hear. Execute one movement budget and one selected legal Action in the attached phase after the entire owner turn. A valid offensive command permits its two printed strikes within one offensive Action, not two owner commands. Choose legal targets and any lawful alternatives from what the owner actually perceives when commanding; revalidate reach, target and line of effect at each attack. Split the one movement budget before/between attacks if declared. A miss or invalid later target does not refund offense or grant a hidden new target. Other companions cannot spend a second offensive Action that numbered round. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge while capable. No independent initiative turn or extra-turn reset is created.
procedure.noncombatUse: A real command may direct its profiled basic Action, manipulation or Search. Carrying and movement use the actual profile and real spent time. It may move supplied cargo or manipulate an unattended simple object, but it supplies no automatic Help advantage, profession, autonomous offscreen project, expedition roster office, extra Watch, training or institutional service. It cannot perform a job requiring missing proficiency or an ability it lacks. Real gear, whole bodies, Load and weight are not erased by apparent magical anatomy. A prospective action must still be physically possible in the available geometry.
procedure.healingNullAndEnding: Use the complete profile's explicit healing and lifecycle clauses. NullDisabled0 is the same occupying body, not an empty formation slot or a new summon. Genuine legal healing above0 restores that body without refreshing its one-hour clock, caster cap or command/offense history. A corporeal condition or loss of hearing can disable command without ending the source. NEW full suppression of this spell-created body or its whole ongoing summon record ends the body and its source; narrower suppression of a rider does not silently end it. The caster can dismiss it on their regular turn without an Action. At source ending, actually carried/held real objects drop at its real current position and use ordinary support/Falling. Intrinsic attacks/anatomy vanish without loot, corpse, XP from destruction or resource triggers. There is no homeward transit or guaranteed rescue, because no preexisting external person was borrowed. An independent spell that moves the same ally elsewhere keeps its current source and remaining clock.

AC6-PRICE-01.status: NEW AC6 bridge using accepted AC5 pricing order; does not alter AC5.
AC6-PRICE-01.rule: For an ordinary AC6 spell, start from its actual base spell RP price (rank6 generally 13; Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is 21). Apply accepted Resonance Nexus ordinary -2 spell-price reduction first when genuinely eligible, then mandatory Resonance Dampening Field +2 if applicable, then final Resonance Influence Ease/Strain. A discount never changes generating rank. Resonance Forge cycle 5 RP is protected conversion principal and is not a spell price or subject to these modifiers.

AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.status: NEW per-card dealer/root mapping constrained by accepted Null/damage-root rules.
AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.rule: Forbiddance: caster is dealer at each new field exposure root. Chain Arc: caster is dealer and one shared selection/damage event still creates recipient-specific damage roots using that caster state at root creation. Skybrand: effect has no creature identity; caster is dealer separately for each attack root. Greater Air Pet, Faction Army soldier and Greater Planar Ally are their own creature dealers for their own attacks/auras. Pure damage transfer preserves the original root flag; genuinely new reflected damage follows its source.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.
AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.rule: While the original summon source exists, Greater Air Pet and each Faction Army soldier body count as an active creature and living ally for otherwise legal HP-healing. This grants no natural biology, soul/native origin, resurrection, disease/curse treatment or generic summon healing. A genuine heal above 0 restores the same NullDisabled body without refreshing source duration or command history. Greater Planar Ally uses GA-HEAL-01 instead.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

AC6-COMPANION-01.rule: All actual commanded companions/devices of one owner share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round unless a source explicitly overrides it. Commands occur during the owner regular turn, require actual channel/range/perception/LoE as printed, and execute in the attached phase after the whole owner turn. Extra turns do not reset the ledger. A newly created asset may receive an otherwise available command that round, but creation gives no free attack.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. Use a fair physical die with equal face mapping when practical; otherwise use an exact uniform N-entry draw. A legal reroll such as Fate Coin replaces that one original selection result against the unchanged candidate array and must use the replacement. Hidden Director-only draws remain hidden; a player who cannot perceive the die/event cannot spend Fate Coin. Once a successor is committed, later immunity, death, movement or lawful removal does not redraw earlier/later committed successors.

AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.status: Current negative interoperability conclusion; no new dispel permission created.
AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.rule: Resonance Seal protection cannot currently be selectively suppressed and then dispelled through the same accepted Lesser Antimagic/Greater Dispel transaction. Accepted Greater Dispel captures immutable termination operations; only the operation targeting the suppressing Antimagic field ignores that same field. Operations targeting Seal/parent at suppressed loci are suppressed and are not rescanned after field removal. Wizard class Dispel is a rank3 spell and is itself suppressed when its application locus is suppressed. An actual future/selective source could change this only through its exact text.

AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.status: NEW scoped Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 classification only.
AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.rule: Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 gateway crossings are both planar transitions and teleportation for predicates that expressly reference either. This is source-specific and does not change accepted AC5 Alignment Portal, which remains planar/extradimensional and non-teleport. Voluntary crossing therefore interacts with No Escape, Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes according to each exact predicate; forced movement remains governed by the exact voluntary/benefit wording.

AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.status: NEW bounded Nexus Conjuration8 benefit; no plane ontology claim.
AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.rule: While the Nexus parent remains live, an aligned creature physically present on the designated destination plane may receive the source-specific temporary +2 Nexus benefit at the events the Nexus procedure states. This does not make that plane intrinsically aligned, identify Wheel cosmology, infer soul/native origin, or grant the bonus after parent ending. Eligibility uses current effective alignment under accepted overlay ordering.

AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.status: NEW Resonance Forge conversion interface using Forge revision02.
AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.rule: After a legal Forge cast, each complete cycle costs exactly 5 actual RP from one capable present participant plus 10 uninterrupted actual active minutes by the required workers and credits up to 60 adjusted manufacturing minutes in the current source work phase. The 5 RP is protected conversion principal, not an ordinary spell price. Interrupted cycles spend RP/time but give no cycle credit. A completed cycle does not independently stabilize an unfinished phase; source phase boundaries control stabilized work. Ordinary reviewed crafting XP/first-success/triviality remain in force.

AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.status: NEW family guard for the two Alignment Nexus modes.
AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.rule: One Alignment Nexus parent application per caster. Divination6 and Conjuration8 are distinct operations of one source identity; successful replacement ends the previous parent after normal commitment. Each event receives at most one Nexus bonus from this spell family even if multiple geometric/plane predicates might otherwise overlap.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.status: NEW AC6 scoped completion chosen for coherence with accepted AC5 same-body paused summons.
AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.rule: Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. The same body, identity, HP, Null state, deadline, carried real cargo and source parent remain; manifestation is suppressed, Speed becomes 0 and it cannot act, command, attack, provide intrinsic attacks/traits or satisfy physical-service permissions from the suppressed source. All real clocks continue. If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. When suppression ends before source ending, the same body resumes at the same legal position/state; no missed action/command is replayed.

AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.classification: NEW current-authority promotion/clock clarification for Alignment Nexus only
AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.rule: The full Divination6 and Conjuration8 procedures stored historically in completePriorDraftRecord.modes are promoted into current procedure. Divination6 maximum concentration is60 elapsed seconds; Conjuration8 maximum concentration is600 elapsed seconds. This changes no source/access placement.

AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.classification: NEW AC6-specific physical consequence of full suppression
AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.rule: When AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 fully suppresses Greater Air Pet, its intrinsic fly/hover expression is suppressed. If unsupported, ordinary Falling begins under the existing Falling bridge on the same preserved body. NullDisabled0 alone does not suppress Hover.

AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05.classification: NEW source-specific Chain Arc successor geometry; proposed for joint review, not a global range amendment
rule: Use the actual occupied body volumes in the pre-damage snapshot for every size, including Medium, Large and the caster. A successor is in local range only if one point on the previous body and one point on the candidate body are at most30feet apart AND the straight segment connecting that same pair has actual clear line of effect on the same actual plane. Do not combine the distance of a blocked pair with the line of effect of a different out-of-range pair. Do not mix center measurements for smaller creatures with nearest-body measurements for larger ones.

Include each unvisited qualifying actual creature identity exactly once, including allies, unseen bodies and the caster. Exclude already visited identities, objects, corpses and images. Stable preexisting identity order precedes each fair draw. This is only the successor test: the initial declared target still needs its actual60foot range, caster perception and line of effect.

Bodies have extent. The60foot initial range and five30foot jumps bound their respective targeting gaps, not a universal center-to-center distance to the last body. No arbitrary remote endpoint or unprinted conductive path is added.

AC6-SKYBRAND-ORIGIN-06.classification: Explicit AC6 Skybrand spatial-attack clarification proposed for joint review; no change to damage-root ownership or global condition rules
rule: Skybrand remains a caster-dealt noncreature effect. For its actual melee spell attack, use the blade current attack-origin point for reach, attack line of effect and distance-based attack predicates, including Prone and the within5feet Unconscious/Paralyzed critical-hit rule. This does not relocate the caster body, grant remote senses, create a creature attacker or change the caster-dealer root checkpoint.

Apply current conditions at each separate attack. Against an ordinarily Unconscious target within5feet of the blade, the attack has ordinary advantage and any hit is critical. Multiple advantage sources do not stack. Double only damage dice; ordinary damage at already0HP applies two death failures for a critical when the target uses death saves. Actual Null qualification still uses the caster state at that attack root.
